data.subject: Local Ledger for Rangeley
data.body:
Hi,

Rangeley Capital’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in STHO and FLL.

BHR had a preliminary contested proxy filing (PREC14A) filed on October 14, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1574085/000109690626001545/0001096906-26-001545-index.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue from public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
